summary: High Wire Networks, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a Securities Purchase Agreement with GHS Investments, LLC, under which it issued 46 shares of Series G Preferred Stock at $1,000/share for $34,000 cash plus a 12-share equity incentive. The preferred stock has a stated value of $1,200, carries a 12% dividend, and is convertible into common stock. An additional 70 shares may be sold in future closings. This is a private placement of equity securities, not a special-situation event like a tender offer, going-private transaction, or restructuring. No premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. This appears to be a routine capital-raising arrangement filed under Items 1.01 and 3.02.
